integrations._comment: Since 1.34.0 the parent's child profiles page. The sidebar entry shape is { href, label } with no role field, so the Instructor link (System Managers and instructors only) is drawn role-gated on the LMS dashboard instead (dashboard/quick-links.tsx via fetchLmsNavLinks).

The drizzle migration scripts travel with the drizzle config/schema this SDK installs; the bare shell's package.json carries neither. Inserted after the host's lint script line (idempotent: skipped when already present).
